notesForHumanAdjudicator: The two numeric targets match: 42 per week, and about 16 per week from 205 remaining pages (reference 15.94). Accuracy gets 0.75 for small internal inconsistencies: the 'other' bucket is called both 14 and 17 alerts, and the description of when Berlin nights fall in PT is loose. A further looseness: it equates 1-in-4 weekly 12-hour rotation to the '25% ceiling' even though actual on-call time is about 12.5%. I checked fixture-derived figures for internal consistency only and did not re-read the source files. The German legal citations (BetrVG, ArbZG, CJEU) were not verified, but the output hedges them appropriately.
